faqs.q: What is the group size for Delightful India Holidays group tours?
faqs.a: Our group tours typically accommodate small to medium groups ranging from 6 to 18 travelers to ensure personalized attention, comfort, and flexibility.

faqs.q: Are transportation and AC coach included in group tour packages?
faqs.a: Yes, all intercity transfers and sightseeing are operated in modern, climate-controlled luxury coaches (Tempo Traveller or Volvo Coach) with experienced drivers and onboard amenities.

faqs.q: Are group tours suitable for families and senior citizens?
faqs.a: Absolutely! Our group itineraries are thoughtfully paced with comfortable hotel stays, accessible sightseeing, and dedicated tour coordinators to assist every member.

faqs.q: Can we customize a private group tour for corporate or family groups?
faqs.a: Yes, we specialize in bespoke private group tours for extended families, corporate retreats, and alumni groups with customized vehicles and itineraries.
